programme.title: Night of the Demon
programme.desc: (AKA Curse of the Demon) 1957. Horror. Director: Jacques Tourneur. Stars Dana Andrews, Peggy Cummins & Niall MacGinnis. A professor arrives in London and investigates a devil worshipper. [S]

programme.title: The Wasp Woman
programme.desc: 1959. Sci-fi. Director: Roger Corman. Stars Susan Cabot, Anthony Eisley & Barboura Morris. The head of a cosmetics company experiments with a youth formula, unaware of the deadly side effects. [S]

programme.title: A Hole Lot of Trouble
programme.desc: Directed by Francis A Searle. A 1969 comedy short centring around workmen digging a hole. Starring Arthur Lowe, Victor Maddern, Bill Maynard and Tim Barrett. [S]

programme.title: in the 70s with Bernard Cribbins.
programme.desc: Bernard Cribbins presents 'Safety makes Sense' looking at the jobs of School Dinner Ladies in the 1970s and the workings of a large kitchen and its 70s machinery. [S]

programme.title: The Adventures of Sir Lancelot
programme.desc: Prince of Limerick. 1957. Stars William Russell, Cyril Smith & Ronald Leigh-Hunt. A rhyming bandit plagues Brian & Lancelot as they go to Ireland for a tournament as King Arthur's representatives. [S]

programme.title: Honey West
programme.desc: 1965. Don't Look Now, But Isn't That Me? Classic crime series produced by Aaron Spelling and starring Anne Francis. Honey pursues a ring of thieves, one of whom disguises herself as Honey.

programme.title: Talk About Jacqueline
programme.desc: 1942. Comedy. Director: Harold French & Paul L. Stein. Stars Hugh Williams & Carla Lehmann. A woman meets a researcher. When they marry, he runs across some scandalous gossip about her past. [S]

programme.title: Daniel Boone, Trail Blazer
programme.desc: 1956. Western. Directed by Albert C. Gannaway & Ismael Rodríguez. Stars Bruce Bennett & Lon Chaney Jr. Frontiersman Daniel Boone and his family fight for survival when his settlement is attacked. [S]

programme.title: The Long & The Short & The Tall
programme.desc: 1961. War. Directed by Leslie Norman. Stars Richard Todd, Laurence Harvey & Richard Harris. Based on the Willis Hall play. A British patrol in Burma are determined to avenge British prisoners. [S]

programme.title: Batman
programme.desc: Catwoman's Dressed to Kill. 1967. Stars Adam West, Burt Ward, Yvonne Craig & Eartha Kitt. The Caped Crusader must find a way to save Batgirl from Catwoman and prevent any harm to Queen Bess. [S]

programme.title: The Wicked Lady
programme.desc: 1945. Drama. Directed by Leslie Arliss. Stars Margaret Lockwood, Griffith Jones & James Mason. 17th Century beauty Barbara Worth leads a double life to relieve her boredom. [S]

programme.title: The Lamp Still Burns
programme.desc: 1943. Drama. Director: Maurice Elvey. Stars Rosamund John, Stewart Granger, Godfrey Tearle. Architect Hilary Clark decides to become a nurse. Follow her battle between her heart and her vocation. [S]

programme.title: For the Love of Ada
programme.desc: Spring. 1970. Stars Wilfred Pickles, Irene Handl & Jack Smethurst. Walter proposes to Ada, but struggles to find the money for the ring she likes. (S1, E06) [S]

programme.title: The Man from U.N.C.L.E
programme.desc: Alexander the Great Affair: Part Two. 1965. Stars Robert Vaughn, David McCallum & Leo G. Carroll. Solo, Kuryakin and Tracey escape Alexander's death trap. Solo is menaced by a muscular thug. [S]

programme.title: The Footage Detectives
programme.desc: Mike & Noel head to 1970s London to join the River Patrol, then march back to wartime Edinburgh with a remarkable reel & is that Leslie Phillips in Sherwood Forest? All will be revealed. [S]

programme.title: A Kid For Two Farthings
programme.desc: 1955. Drama. Director: Carol Reed. Stars Diana Dors, Celia Johnson, David Kossoff, Brenda De Banzie. A boy, who's heartbroken when his pet chicken disappears, buys a goat believing it's a unicorn. [S]

programme.title: Scotland Yard
programme.desc: 1954. The Blazing Caravan. Director: Ken Hughes. Stars Edgar Driver, Alan Robinson & Betty Carter. A Salesman turns murderer after learning that his client has just won the football pools. (S1, E04)

programme.title: Francis Durbridge's A Game of Murder
programme.desc: 1966. Stars Gerald Harper, June Barry & Conrad Phillips. More secrets are uncovered by Jack Kerry. Are the pieces of this mystery slowly coming together? [S]

programme.title: Sherlock Holmes: The Eligible Bachelor
